thread:
violet: Quick flag  post-migration we're getting reports of deep links landing at top-of-page for /guides/installer and /guides/cluster. Two support tickets so far.
omar: Examples?
violet: /guides/installer#service-accounts and /guides/cluster#autoscaling both jump to top.
docs-bot: nightly linkcheck: 3 broken fragments in build 4720. Report: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4720/linkcheck
lee: Likely culprits: headings moved inside MDX wrappers (slug changed) or accidentally indented became code blocks (no slug).
omar: Quick fixes: add explicit ids on high-traffic headings (e.g., `## Service accounts {#service-accounts}`) and unindent any headings trapped in code blocks.
violet: Can someone run a grep for indented headings? `rg "^\s{4,}#{1,6} " docs/guides | sed -n '1,200p'`. I'll patch installer and cluster today.
docs-bot: CI artifact: current slugs available at https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4720/slugs.json
lee: For external links we should emit redirects.json. I'll prototype a slug-compat generator that diffs git history slugs -> current slugs and emits mappings for docusaurus redirects plugin.
omar: Also propose temporarily setting `onBrokenLinks: 'warn'` while we land mass fixes so deploys aren't blocked. Notify infra.
violet: Action items: violet -> patch content (explicit ids + unindent); lee -> slugmap proto & sample redirects.json; omar -> coordinate CI tweak and add small linkcheck unit asserting a few canonical anchors. Ping when PRs are ready.
docs-bot: Reminder: nightly rebuild at 02:00 UTC will re-run linkcheck after merges.
